title: Dxcufgb's token context menu
description: Replaces the loose icons of the Token HUD (right-click a token) with a context menu that shows every icon together with its description. Status effects and other palettes open as sub-menus. Adds Follow (Dxcufgb's token follower) and Ride (Rideable) entries when those modules are active.

recommends.reason: Adds an 'Animated token ring' entry to the menu that opens Lively Tokens' ring window.
Adds a 'Follow this token' entry to the menu.
Adds a 'Ride' entry to the menu on rideable tokens.
